home.headline: Greater than the sum of its parts.
home.subline: Luxury begins with exceptional manufacturing and thoughtful interfaces, effortless to use and built to last. At the heart of a smart home, one sophisticated interface unifies what would otherwise be a disjointed collection of gadgets. That surface is LIT Home.
home.brandWallSub: These are the manufacturers whose hardware Leading IT specifies, supplies and installs from Dubai, for the UAE and Pakistan. Each one is carried for what its equipment does in a real room, not to widen a catalogue.
home.litTeaserBody: Hardware and software designed together, so the interface behaves the way the room does. It removes unnecessary complexity, leaving control that is powerful and entirely your own.
home.lifestyleQuote: Luxury is not what you add. It is what you remove until only intention remains.
home.lifestyleAttribution: — from the Leading IT design brief

designer.entryBody: Compose a keypad the way it will sit on the wall — choose the collection, layout and finish, engrave each button, and set the backlight. Send the exact specification to our team without leaving the site.
designer.productCta: Configure a {{name}} keypad for your project.
designer.heroBody: An on-site version of Black Nova's create-your-keypad pipeline, in the Leading IT design language. Build your keypad, then request it, send it on WhatsApp, or share the link — your design is saved in the address bar.
designer.seoDescription: Design a bespoke Black Nova keypad online — choose the ALBA, ARIA, ANY, AXES or Black Jack collection, layout, finish, engraving and RGB backlight. Supplied in the UAE and Pakistan by Leading IT.
designer.collectionHint: Start with the Black Nova collection that suits the room — push-button, glass touch, smart panel, hospitality or the Meljac capsule.
designer.layoutHint: Choose a {{collection}} layout. The layout names are Black Nova's own — the preview grid is illustrative.
designer.finishHint: Select a finish. Glass, metal and marble — the metal finishes are hand-brushed and plated.
designer.engravingHint: Pick a button, give it a label, and choose an icon. The preview updates live.
designer.backlightHint: Every keypad carries an independently dimmable RGB backlight. Choose a colour and intensity.
designer.summaryHint: Your design is complete. Send it to our team, share it on WhatsApp, or copy the link to return to it later.
designer.noEngraving: The {{layout}} layout has no engravable push buttons — it is driven by its display or LED matrix. Continue to backlight and summary.
designer.disclaimer: Preview is illustrative. Icon artwork and layout are shown for design intent; production engraving uses Black Nova's official icon library and finishing.
designer.specHeading: Black Nova keypad design — via Leading IT

about.title: Engineers, not a sales team.
about.lead: If you are looking for a sales team, we will likely disappoint you. We are a team of engineers who genuinely know our solutions. We have one unifying purpose: to help our clients select, procure and integrate quality solutions that exceed their clients' expectations. We are not just moving boxes; we provide value through the entire system life cycle.
